title: Imperial Photos Go Viral: Emperor, Empress & Princess Aiko's 4 Shots Garner 50K Likes in 3 Hours
text:
TOKYO, Aug. 17, 2023 — The Emperor and Empress, along with Princess Aiko , enjoyed a relaxing summer retreat that has captured the public’s attention. Four precious photographs released from their time together, including snapshots taken by the Emperor himself, garnered an astonishing 50,000 likes within just three hours of their release.
The Emperor’s family’s “sea shot” has brought joy to many online.
The Japanese Imperial family’s recent seaside retreat photos have garnered significant public appreciation.
New photos of the Emperor, Empress, and Princess Aiko were released following their summer retreat. The images, taken at Susaki Imperial Household’s first residence in six years, show the family smiling on the beach. The Emperor also captured photos of fish during the outing. The release garnered widespread positive reaction online, with many praising the relaxed atmosphere. The Imperial Household Agency shared the heartwarming images, marking the first time in six years the Susaki Imperial Household’s residence hosted the family for a retreat. These moments offer a glimpse into the private lives of the Emperor and his family, fostering a sense of connection with the public.
A Relaxing Escape The photographs depict the Emperor and Empress alongside Princess Aiko, all smiling on a beach. One particular shot, featuring Princess Aiko in a rash guard, has been singled out for its heartwarming appeal, with one observer noting, “My heart is relaxing.” The collection also includes candid shots of the family enjoying their time together.
The Emperor’s own photography skills were also on display, with images of fish he captured during the retreat shared alongside the family portraits. This personal touch has added another layer of engagement for those following the Imperial family’s activities.
The overwhelming public response underscores a desire for these more personal glimpses into the lives of the Imperial household. The released images have clearly resonated, offering a moment of shared joy and relaxation for many.
